verdict.rationale: PayPal documents broad REST API coverage of the merchant back office: orders, refunds, voids and delayed capture, subscriptions, invoicing, payouts, and disputes. The Disputes API explicitly mirrors the Resolution Center UI, and dashboard actions like refunds and shipment tracking have API equivalents via the agent toolkit inventory. OpenAPI specs, webhooks, an MCP server and the agent toolkit round this out, but nothing states full UI/API parity, and several UI features (no-code Payment Links, consumer wallet features) have no evidenced API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API evidence for Payment Links and the consumer account features shown in the UI, and independent hands-on corroboration of coverage.
